confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and the city context; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately certain. Accommodation anchors (especially hotel_3star_2p, which varies a lot by season and resort) are less certain. Cocktail and wine_glass are estimated from the local beer relationship, since direct knowledge of Langkawi bar pricing is weak. The FX observation came from a search snippet attributed to the RBA homepage. I did not open that page or corroborate the figure with a second RBA source, so verify it against the RBA F11.1 daily table before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Malaysian tourist-island pricing (Penang and Kota Kinabalu style venues), with lodging priced toward resort-island levels for Langkawi in July.
